extra.final_summary: The data had three main issues: (1) whitespace variants in the 'sex' column were normalized to 'male' and 'female'; (2) the 'body_mass_g' column was stored as text with commas and was converted to numbers; (3) three rows had body mass values far outside the valid range (2500–6500 grams) and were excluded as likely errors. Two duplicate rows were also removed. After fixes, the total body mass by species is: Adelie: 73,200 g, Chinstrap: 28,100 g, Gentoo: 61,525 g.
